about_the_game:
This is a true deck builder. Before each fight, you craft your deck from an ever growing library of unlocked cards. Earn experience, unlock new cards, and customize your loadout freely. 

Unlike most card games, you don’t just receive energy each turn, you decide how much you want. Discard cards during your energy phase to generate the energy you need. Burn your hand for a burst of power or hold back for later turns. It’s your call, every time.

With an ever-expanding library of cards and full control over your deck before each battle. Discover powerful synergies and unleash combo abilities. Each combat card serves a dual role, used for attacking or defending, depending on the current phase of combat. Many cards have discard effects, use these to your advantage.

Set in a quirky medieval world full of chibi knights and offbeat monsters, each battle is a compact, tactical challenge with big strategic depth.

Key Features

  • Deckbuilding, For Real – Freely build and change your deck from your unlocked library before every fight.

  • Player-Driven Energy System – Discard cards to generate energy—manage your hand and your momentum.

  • Unlock as You Go – Earn XP and expand your card library through battles and exploration. Not reliant on RNG.

  • Stylized Adventure – A cute but deadly world of tiny knights and oversized enemies.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

⚠️ This page is a work in progress. Access is currently limited to early play testers. We truly appreciate your support as we refine our mechanics and gameplay—your feedback is invaluable!

The game's art style and character designs are finalized and will remain consistent through to release. However, many assets you see are still placeholders. While this build focuses primarily on gameplay, we're also working hard to bring the visual elements closer to the final version.⚠️

name: Drawn To Power

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD Graphics 3000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Best played at 1080p. Game is lightweight and runs on most systems from the last 10 years.
